evidence.quote: You can fetch a list of admins for a given workspace.
You can get a log of activities by all admins in an app.
The default is `20` results per page and maximum is `150`.

assumptions: The source lists three regional hosts (US, EU, AU). I used the US host https://api.intercom.io. Workspaces hosted in Europe or Australia would need the matching host.
The source does not document a pagination mechanism for the admins list, so I assumed it returns all teammates in a single response.
Admin records have no status, role or last-active field in the source, so those are left empty. Teammates who were removed may not appear in the list.
The activity log endpoint is the only usage signal for teammates. It records admin actions such as logins, not product usage in general.
I assumed the activity log time filters (created_at_after, created_at_before) take epoch seconds, because created_at is an integer. The source does not say so.
The required created_at_after parameter is now set explicitly in the activity log request query from the window start.
I assumed activity log pages are fetched with a starting_after cursor taken from pages.next.starting_after. The source shows this shape but gives no page size parameter for this endpoint.
Activity log entries identify the admin by email (performed_by.email). Entries without an email will not match a user.
The source does not state the access token scopes or plan needed, and gives no rate limit details.
Intercom-Version header is set to 2.11 to match the declared API version.
